articles.title: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as ‘biggest breakthrough in decades’
articles.description: Cancer undetectable for one in 12 patients in daraxonrasib trial, while nearly all participants’ tumours stopped growing A pill that can shrink and potentially eliminate pancreas tumours is being hailed as the biggest breakthrough treatment for the cancer in decades. articles.title: Athlete who lost hand saving friends in attack 'would do it again'
articles.description: Ismael Ox was 11 years old when he lost his hand trying to protect his friends from a grenade - and now competes in Para-taekwondo for the USA.

articles.title: Shevchenko lying about drugs test claims - Mudryk
